title: fleet-activity/1 — one event in the fleet activity store (HUB-072)
description: The single envelope every activity producer writes and every reader receives: container lifecycle and resource events, Claude Code hook events, agent sessions, console jobs and HUB-024 fleet_event rows, each tagged by `source` (FR66, FR69, NFR13). Major version 1: changes are additive only (a new optional field, a new source or kind); a removal or a meaning change is fleet-activity-2.json. Unknown top-level fields are rejected so a typo fails loudly: a new field is added here first, then produced. Decisions: docs/prd/FLEET-ACTIVITY-REPLAY-DECISIONS.md. Fixtures: schemas/fixtures/fleet-activity-1/, checked by tools/test_activity_contract.py.

schema.description: The envelope's major version. Every event carries it so a reader can refuse a major it does not know.

event_id.description: Lowercase UUID set by the producer when the event is first spooled; the idempotency key of the at-least-once flush (INSERT … ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO NOTHING). A wrapped HUB-024 fleet_event keeps its own event_id.

ts.description: When it happened at the source, in UTC (Z or +00:00), not when it was flushed. Replay timing reads this; replay order reads `cursor`.

source.description: Which producer family wrote it. `harness` is reserved for the harness protocol (#626, schemas/harness-event-1.json), which owns that source's kinds and payload profile; no producer emits it before that lands, and `_data/fleet.yml` `observability.activity.sources` leaves it out.

kind.description: Namespaced event kind, always `<source>.<what>`: container.start / die / oom / health_status, hook.pre_tool_use, session.turn, job.stalled, fleet_event.declined, harness.task.started.

seq.description: Producer sequence: strictly increasing within one (node, source) stream, assigned when the event is appended to that stream's spool. A gap is a lost event, so drops stay countable after the fact (NFR13); the writer never renumbers.

cursor.description: Store sequence, assigned by the Postgres writer on insert and never by a producer: the global replay order and the SSE Last-Event-ID, one format for live and replay (FR67). Present on events read back from the store.

node.description: Where it happened: a host key from `_data/fleet.yml` `nodes.hosts` (mac, forge), or `ci` for a GitHub-hosted runner.

project.description: The `com.bamr87.fleet.project` label or registry name (`bamr87` for the hub).

repo.description: owner/name, from the `com.bamr87.fleet.repo` label, the registry or the git remote.

service.description: Compose service name, when the container belongs to one.

actor.description: Who acted: an agent (claude-code, a subagent type), a loop or a bot id. A wrapped fleet_event's bot_id lands here; FR67 filters on it as `agent`.

run_id.description: Correlates the events of one run: a Claude Code session id for hook and session events, the console job id for job events, the Docker container id for container events, the HUB-024 run_id for fleet_event.

trace_id.description: W3C trace id, 32 lowercase hex, never all zeros: the same id Phoenix and Elasticsearch carry (fleet_lake.trace_id_for), so any event opens its trace tree (FR69).

span_id.description: W3C span id, 16 lowercase hex, never all zeros: the span inside `trace_id` this event belongs to.

pipeline_node.description: Node id in diagrams/pipeline-map/pipeline.json when the event maps onto one (FR17, FR18).

payload.description: Small source-specific JSON, redacted before it is spooled; never raw log text. The serialized size is capped by `observability.activity.caps.payload_max_bytes`, which the writer enforces. Every string and key is checked against the token patterns below, so a payload that still holds a token is not a valid event.

allOf.$comment: container: label-gated capture, so every event names its container and project label; the run is the container instance (its Docker id).
hook: one Claude Code hook call; kind is hook.<hook_event_name in snake_case>.
session: an agent session's lifecycle, diffed from the live collector's snapshots.
job: a console job's state transition, the FR60 states.
fleet_event: a HUB-024 row carried whole. event_id, ts, repo and run_id are lifted to the envelope, bot_id becomes actor, the rest of the row is the payload.
harness: reserved. The kinds after `harness.` and the payload profile are #626's schemas/harness-event-1.json; this envelope owns only the common fields.

redacted.description: Recursively: no string value and no object key may still hold a token. The pattern is the union of tools/fleet_activity.py's redaction and `_data/fleet.yml` `observability.logs.redact` (tools/test_activity_contract.py plants each prefix and expects a rejection).
